entry.title: econet and other acorn specific networking • Re: vbit2 teletext & PEB

category.term: econet and other acorn specific networking
category.label: econet and other acorn specific networking

entry.content:
Anyhow, can anyone share the vbit2 TCP protocol with me?
There isn't really a protocol as such, you just open a socket and start reading fields of 672 bytes. i.e. 16 × 42 byte packets. i.e. teletext packet minus clock run in and framing.
The server immediately begins throwing frames of teletext at the client until it either disconnects, or the buffer clogs the data not being consumed fast enough.
